{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for multiple use of public lands conducted in an environmentally and economically sustainable manner.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to preserving high priority wilderness and wetlands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Everglades are a crucial example of a special federal responsibility.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Call for a review of lands owned by the national government—half the total territory of Western States—to develop a comprehensive plan to better manage existing holdings.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"In some cases, the review of lands owned by the national government may mean transferring or sharing responsibility for managing those lands with state or local governments.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All levels of government should recognize existing rights to water, minerals, and grazing.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reaffirmation of traditional state primacy over water allocations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to continue the availability of renewable rangeland under conditions that ensure both expanded production of livestock and protection of the range environment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Reaffirmation of commitment to preserve access to public lands for multiple use.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recognition of the vital role the timber industry plays in the economy, particularly in homebuilding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for the timber industry's efforts to improve the health of the country's forests.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A Republican administration will promote sustainable forest management, using the best science in place of the no-growth policies that have devastated communities in the Pacific Northwest and Alaska.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
